newsitem.title: TURKEY: Erbakan's package to raise $10 billion for Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Erbakan's package to raise $10 billion for Turkey.

text.p: ANKARA, Nov 25 (Reuetr) - Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan on Monday unveiled a third revenue-raising package in four months, hoping to bring in $10 billion to help plug gaping deficits.

Erbakan told a news conference the bulk of the revenue, $6.87 billion, would be generated by leasing 35 power stations and distribution networks. He did not say how long it would take for the total revenue to be raised.
The prime minister pledged to collect a further $2 billion by reducing payments on overdue debt to the public sector, while an additional $1 billion would be garnered changes in labour regulations.
The government also hopes to raise $200 million by taxing earnings from foreign bonds and bills held by Turkish investors.
Erbakan said Turkish banks held $700 million worth of foreign bonds in their portfolios.
